title: [Advisory] Drupal: Upcoming Critical Security Release Nov. 2026
content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Successful exploitation could compromise affected Drupal websites; the specific attack vector and technical impact remain undisclosed.
- **Current exploitation status**: UNKNOWN

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- Drupal — Drupal core

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:
- **Available Mitigations:**
  - Security patches are upcoming; review and deploy the releases immediately when published

##### REFERENCES:

Primary:
- Source Advisory: https://www.drupal.org/psa-2026-11-16

*Timestamp of the Information: 17.11.2026, 11:01*
summary: Drupal has announced upcoming critical security releases on November 18 2026 for Drupal core and advises administrators to prepare for immediate deployment. Technical vulnerability details have not yet been publicly disclosed.
